name: Sterling Rose
headline: Co-Founder @ Limebox | Netsuite Development, Salesforce Customization, IT Consulting Firm
about:
As a co-founder and partner at Limebox, I leverage my NetSuite Certified SuiteFoundation credential and over 10 years of NetSuite functional and development expertise to deliver customized solutions for clients' business objectives. Limebox is a consulting services company that specializes in NetSuite and CRM systems, helping clients optimize their processes, integrations, and user experience.

My strength lies in my ability to use business analysis skills and creative problem-solving to design and implement solutions that enhance the functionality and performance of NetSuite and CRM platforms. I have developed custom integrations with Slack and Google Sheets, as well as plugins that improve the NetSuite UI and save time and money for clients. I also have experience with Salesforce, building out custom objects and workflows for specific needs. My mission is to empower clients with the best tools and practices for their business success.
… more

experiences.description: I work with clients to understand their pain points and come up with solutions. Whether it involves a change in process or a system enhancement or both, I like to take the time to come up with the best solution for your needs. In addition to that I have developed many 'plugins' that work to enhance Netsuite core functionality, improve the user experience and save your company time and money. I also have experience working with Salesforce building out custom objects and workflows to achieve record tracking and automation for a specific client need.

Manage Netsuite instance and team including Administrator, Developer, QA Analyst and Support Analyst. Served as the primary product owner and system architect in addition to supporting technical knowledge transfer to my team.

I maintain all of our business systems including but not limited to: Netsuite, G Suite (Google Apps), OneLogin, Magento, AWS, Google Cloud Services, Asterisk PBX, Local networking, Zebra Printers, Desktop support.

Work extensively to streamline business tasks in Netsuite through use of workflow automation and SuiteScript. Netsuite is the core of our business processes and holds all of our product, customer, and order data. 

Maintain our Magento server on Google Cloud Compute, software installation, and front end design as well as integrations to Netsuite accounting software and other services. 

Also responsible for implementing new technologies and strategic plans to streamline our business tasks.
